# Resource: tfe_saml_settings

(Only for Terraform Enterprise) Creates, updates, and destroys SAML settings.

Requires admin token configuration. See example usage for incorporating an admin token in your provider config.

## Example Usage

```go
import constructs "github.com/aws/constructs-go/constructs"
import "github.com/hashicorp/terraform-cdk-go/cdktf"
/*Provider bindings are generated by running cdktf get.
See https://cdk.tf/provider-generation for more details.*/
import "github.com/aws-samples/dummy/gen/providers/tfe/samlSettings"
import "github.com/aws-samples/dummy/gen/providers/tfe/provider"
type myConvertedCode struct {
	TerraformStack
}

func newMyConvertedCode(scope Construct, name *string) *myConvertedCode {
	this := &myConvertedCode{}
	cdktf.NewTerraformStack_Override(this, scope, name)
	/*Terraform Variables are not always the best fit for getting inputs in the context of Terraform CDK.
	    You can read more about this at https://cdk.tf/variables*/
	adminToken := cdktf.NewTerraformVariable(this, jsii.String("admin_token"), &TerraformVariableConfig{
		Description: jsii.String("An admin access token"),
	})
	hostname := cdktf.NewTerraformVariable(this, jsii.String("hostname"), &TerraformVariableConfig{
		Default: jsii.String("app.terraform.io"),
		Description: jsii.String("The HCP Terraform or Enterprise hostname."),
	})
	samlSettings.NewSamlSettings(this, jsii.String("this"), &SamlSettingsConfig{
		idpCert: jsii.String("foobarCertificate"),
		sloEndpointUrl: jsii.String("https://example.com/slo_endpoint_url"),
		ssoEndpointUrl: jsii.String("https://example.com/sso_endpoint_url"),
	})
	provider.NewTfeProvider(this, jsii.String("tfe"), &TfeProviderConfig{
		hostname: hostname.stringValue,
		token: adminToken.stringValue,
	})
	return this
}
```

```terraform
# With write-only private key

variable "admin_token" {
  description = "An admin access token"
}

variable "hostname" {
  description = "The HCP Terraform or Enterprise hostname."
  default     = "app.terraform.io"
}

variable "private_key" {
  type      = string
  ephemeral = true
}

provider "tfe" {
  hostname = var.hostname
  token    = var.admin_token
}

resource "tfe_saml_settings" "this" {
  idp_cert               = "foobarCertificate"
  slo_endpoint_url       = "https://example.com/slo_endpoint_url"
  sso_endpoint_url       = "https://example.com/sso_endpoint_url"
  private_key_wo         = var.private_key
  private_key_wo_version = 1
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `IdpCert` (String) Identity Provider Certificate specifies the PEM encoded X.509 Certificate as provided by the IdP configuration.
- `SloEndpointUrl` (String) Single Log Out URL specifies the HTTPS endpoint on your IdP for single logout requests. This value is provided by the IdP configuration.
- `SsoEndpointUrl` (String) Single Sign On URL specifies the HTTPS endpoint on your IdP for single sign-on requests. This value is provided by the IdP configuration.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `AttrGroups` (String) Team Attribute Name specifies the name of the SAML attribute that determines team membership.
- `AttrSiteAdmin` (String) Specifies the role for site admin access. Overrides the "Site Admin Role" method.
- `AttrUsername` (String) Username Attribute Name specifies the name of the SAML attribute that determines the user's username.
- `AuthnRequestsSigned` (Boolean) Ensure that `<samlp:AuthnRequest>` messages are signed.
- `Certificate` (String) The certificate used for request and assertion signing.
- `Debug` (Boolean) When sign-on fails and this is enabled, the SAMLResponse XML will be displayed on the login page.
- `PrivateKey` (String, Sensitive) The private key used for request and assertion signing.
- `PrivateKeyWo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) The private key in write-only mode used for request and assertion signing. Guaranteed not to be written to plan or state artifacts. Either `PrivateKey` or `PrivateKeyWo` can be provided, but not both. Must be used with `PrivateKeyWoVersion`.
- `PrivateKeyWoVersion` (Number) Version of the write-only private key. This field is used to trigger updates when the write-only private key changes. Must be used with `PrivateKeyWo`. When `PrivateKeyWoVersion` changes, the write-only private key will be updated.
- `ProviderType` (String) The type of identity provider used. Valid values are `Okta`, `Entra`, `Saml`, and `Unknown`. Defaults to `Unknown`.
- `SignatureDigestMethod` (String) Signature Digest Method. Must be either `Sha1` or `Sha256`. Defaults to `Sha256`.
- `SignatureSigningMethod` (String) Signature Signing Method. Must be either `Sha1` or `Sha256`. Defaults to `Sha256`.
- `SiteAdminRole` (String) Specifies the role for site admin access, provided in the list of roles sent in the Team Attribute Name attribute.
- `SsoApiTokenSessionTimeout` (Number) Specifies the Single Sign On session timeout in seconds. Defaults to 14 days.
- `TeamManagementEnabled` (Boolean) Whether Terraform Enterprise manages team membership via SAML. Set to false if you would rather use Terraform Enterprise to manage team membership.
- `WantAssertionsSigned` (Boolean) Ensure that `<saml:Assertion>` elements are signed.

### Read-Only

- `AcsConsumerUrl` (String) ACS Consumer (Recipient) URL.
- `Enabled` (Boolean) Whether or not SAML single sign-on is enabled.
- `Id` (String) The ID of the SAML settings. Always `Saml`.
- `MetadataUrl` (String) Metadata (Audience) URL.
- `OldIdpCert` (String) The previous identity provider certificate, kept after the IdP certificate is updated.



## Import

Resource tfe_saml_settings can be imported in the following format: 

```shell
# via the fixed ID 'saml'
terraform import tfe_saml_settings.this saml
```
